description: Ask the platform's decision model to tune the Title: with `request` (the publisher's words, e.g. "darker and calmer, more generous rewards") it picks variants only for the knobs the request is about; without `request` and without `picks` it tunes every unpinned knob. That costs one decision-model call (a fraction of an AI credit, no limits). With only `picks` ({knob_id: option_id | 0..1 level | true/false}) it is free. Saves NOTHING: returns the plan (picks and each config section before/after). Apply it with tuning_apply, passing the returned picks.

knobs.description: Optional: limit to these knob ids.

picks.description: Explicit choices that override the decision model: {knob_id: option_id | number 0..1 | boolean}.

request.description: What to change, in the publisher's own words. Up to 2000 characters.

title_id.description: TitleID (the -DEV copy or the live one).
